changelog.text: Initial dataset verified from official pages.
Pricing page shows X/Grok-bundled tiers (Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100, Ultra $200) with weekly-refreshing pool; docs page still lists Pro $20/Pro Plus $60. Flagged as conflict.
Pro 200 new subscriptions get a lower allowance; grandfathering through 2026-10-29.
windsurf.com/pricing 404s; Windsurf is now Devin Desktop (renamed 2026-06-02).
Re-checked all vendor pages at 18:15 CT: no price changes. windsurf.com/pricing now redirects to devin.ai/pricing instead of returning 404.
Max 20x price confirmed at $200/mo on the Claude Help Center Max plan page (was marked unknown). Max is monthly-only.

Cursor help center confirms Pro ($20) and Pro+ ($60) are legacy plans, not sold to new customers. Relabelled as legacy; conflict resolved. Added annual prices (Plus $80/yr, Premium $300/yr, Super $1,000/yr, Ultra $2,000/yr).
Added team and business pricing for Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Google, Zed, Amp and Bolt where the vendor publishes it.
Added 8 tools from official pricing pages: Google AI (Jules, Antigravity, Gemini Code Assist), Kiro, Zed, OpenCode Go, Amp, Cline, Replit, Bolt.
Weekly re-check of all 13 tools against their official pricing pages and docs: no price changes. Verified dates updated to 2026-10-20.
